body:
The first few nights, I smoked around 0.5 grams. The first night I didn't experience anything. The second night I was watching a YouTube video doing 30 hits of acid. So then I decided to smoke it, had an extremely bitter taste. Then, I went to bed.
About 4 hours later into my sleep, I have this vivid dreams that only lasted about 10 seconds from my memory. The third night I don't remember but I do  recall having a dream. The fourth night, I was watching a TV show called Prison Break,  in this dream there was a main character breaking back into jail. The fifth night was the best. I am moving out of my house soon, and I pictured myself in a house that was a real nice house, but somebody had already bought it. That dream went on for a long time, and then this scenario switched to me and a few friends at a strip club.
